name: Agate
desc: A slabbed and polished agate read as a macro plate — growth bands of chalcedony marching inward from the cavity wall in milk, honey and carnelian, a druzy quartz vug crowding the last of the void, dark basalt in the corners, and the whole section quietly changing shape because the lapidary is still advancing the cut.

bands.doc: growth bands laid from the cavity wall in to the vug

scale.doc: size of the nodule against the frame — how hard the slab is cropped

energy.doc: polish — strength of the raking sheen and the druzy glint

density.doc: lobe count, wall roughness and mineral grain

hue.doc: re-tints the whole mineral (28 = true honey/carnelian agate)

speed.doc: how fast the cut plane advances and the light crawls

x.doc: raking light azimuth across the polished face

y.doc: light elevation — where the sheen band lands

style.doc: agate: natural chalcedony — milk, grey, honey, carnelian on dark basalt · malachite: botryoidal copper carbonate, silky light-and-dark green rings · blue_lace: pale blue and white lace banding, cool and airy · polarised: non-representational — a petrographic thin section under crossed polars, bands become false-colour birefringence · ink: sumi, the section as tonal washes on paper

act.doc: slice: the cut plane advances steadily, bands migrate forever · bloom: the nodule accretes and wanes across sections · still: a museum plate — the cut barely moves and the light does the work

seed.doc: a new nodule — fresh lobes, wall, band sequence and vug
